release: Agent OS Truthful Full-Stack Control Plane v1

agent_os_control_plane.role: Full-stack truth projection layer, replacing legacy Vite-local observability

gate_1_executable_architecture.notes: Executable contract frozen and landed in Agent-OS-Desktop PR #7.

gate_2_state_reconciliation.notes: Landed via PR #255. RoryReconciler handles typed states (COHERENT, DRIFT, CONFLICT, AMBIGUOUS, NESTED_REPO_DRIFT).

gate_3_runtime_presence.notes: Landed via PR #259 & #265. Enforces zero worker != ONLINE, handles TTL expiration and fencing tokens.

gate_4_api_projection_layer.notes: Landed via Agent-OS-Desktop PR #8. Enforces authority separation, offline modes, and dynamic manifest consumption.

gate_5_frontend_truth_projection.notes: Landed via Agent-OS-Desktop PR #9. Replaced hardcoded mock states; renders explicit degraded/stale/offline semantics.

gate_6_e2e_reconciliation_canary.notes: Landed via Agent-OS-Desktop PR #10. Deterministic fixtures assert zero false LIVE statuses across failure/reconnect permutations.

invariants_certified: local runtime truth, local SQLite truth, Git/source truth and Supabase truth remain distinct but reconcilable
static registry/capability existence never equals LIVE
Vite dev middleware is not the permanent backend contract
nested repo/submodule HEADs participate in source fingerprint
no surface silently closes another surface's intent
